```{r}
raw.data = append(
  append(
    tail(fromJSON(file = "result-3eff60a0b0ec.json"), -78),
    fromJSON(file = "result-33f97d2d95f6.json")
  ),
  fromJSON(file = "result-9f6c2af4c3d9.json"))
length(raw.data)
```

```{r}
workers = Reduce(rbind,
  lapply(raw.data, function(work) 
    data.frame(
      campaignId = work$campaignId,
      workerId = work$workerId,
      taskId = work$taskId,
      totalTime = (work$endTime - work$startTime)/1000/60,
      date = format(as.POSIXct(work$startTime/1000, timezone="GMT", origin="1970-01-01"), "%Y-%m-%d")
    )
  )
)
hist(workers$totalTime[workers$totalTime < 30])
```

```{r}
data = rbindlist(
  Reduce(append,   
    lapply(raw.data, function(work) 
      lapply(work$items, function(item) 
        data.frame(
          workerId = work$workerId,
          file = item$file,
          arousal = as.numeric(item$state$arousal),
          valence = as.numeric(item$state$valence),
          potency = as.numeric(item$state$potency),
          contempt = as.numeric(item$state$contempt),
          touches = item$touches,
          visits = item$visits,
          time = (item$endTime - item$startTime)/1000
        )
      )
    )
  )
)
data = data[file!="NA",]
rownames(data) = 1:nrow(data)
nrow(data)
```

# Find best workers

```{r}
N= aggregate.data.frame(data$arousal, list(data$file), FUN="length")$x
A = data.frame(
  file= aggregate.data.frame(data$arousal, list(data$file), FUN="mean")$Group.1,
  len= N,
  arousal.s= aggregate.data.frame(data$arousal, list(data$file), FUN="sd")$x / sqrt(N),
  valence.s= aggregate.data.frame(data$valence, list(data$file), FUN="sd")$x / sqrt(N),
  potency.s= aggregate.data.frame(data$potency, list(data$file), FUN="sd")$x / sqrt(N),
  contempt.s= aggregate.data.frame(data$contempt, list(data$file), FUN="sd")$x / sqrt(N),
  arousal= aggregate.data.frame(data$arousal, list(data$file), FUN="median")$x,
  valence= aggregate.data.frame(data$valence, list(data$file), FUN="median")$x,
  potency= aggregate.data.frame(data$potency, list(data$file), FUN="median")$x,
  contempt= aggregate.data.frame(data$contempt, list(data$file), FUN="median")$x
)
A=A[A$len>1,]
```

```{r}
plot(A[,c('arousal','valence','potency','contempt')])
```
```{r}
plot(A[,c('arousal.s','valence.s','potency.s','contempt.s','len')])
```

```{r}
up = function(x, p=2) sign(x) * (1-(1-abs(x))^p)
correct.avp = function(x) 50 + 50*up(x/50 - 1)
correct.c = function(c) 100*up(c/100,4)
rate = rep(NA, nrow(data))
for (name in unique(A$file)) {
  ref = A[A$file == name,]
  test = data[data$file == name,]
  rate[data$file == name]=
      dnorm(test$arousal, correct.avp(ref$arousal), ref$arousal.s)*
      dnorm(test$valence, correct.avp(ref$arousal), ref$valence.s)*
      dnorm(test$potency, correct.avp(ref$arousal), ref$potency.s)*
      dnorm(test$contempt, correct.c(ref$arousal), ref$contempt.s)
}
hist(log(rate))
```

```{r}
RW= aggregate.data.frame(rate, list(data$workerId), FUN="mean")
BESTW = RW$Group.1[log(RW$x) > -50]
writeLines(as.character(BESTW[!is.na(BESTW)]), 'bestworkers.csv')
hist(log(RW$x))
```
```{r}
data$bestWorker = data$workerId %in% BESTW
data=data[data$workerId %in% BESTW]
```

# Repeat aggregation with best workers

```{r}
N= aggregate.data.frame(data$arousal, list(data$file), FUN="length")$x
A = data.frame(
  file= aggregate.data.frame(data$arousal, list(data$file), FUN="mean")$Group.1,
  len= N,
  arousal.s= aggregate.data.frame(data$arousal, list(data$file), FUN="sd")$x / sqrt(N),
  valence.s= aggregate.data.frame(data$valence, list(data$file), FUN="sd")$x / sqrt(N),
  potency.s= aggregate.data.frame(data$potency, list(data$file), FUN="sd")$x / sqrt(N),
  contempt.s= aggregate.data.frame(data$contempt, list(data$file), FUN="sd")$x / sqrt(N),
  arousal= aggregate.data.frame(data$arousal, list(data$file), FUN="median")$x,
  valence= aggregate.data.frame(data$valence, list(data$file), FUN="median")$x,
  potency= aggregate.data.frame(data$potency, list(data$file), FUN="median")$x,
  contempt= aggregate.data.frame(data$contempt, list(data$file), FUN="median")$x
)
A=A[A$len>1,]
```

```{r}
plot(A[,c('arousal','valence','potency','contempt')])
```

```{r}
up = function(x, p=2) sign(x) * (1-(1-abs(x))^p)
correct.avp = function(x) 50 + 50*up(x/50 - 1)
correct.c = function(c) 100*up(c/100,4)
rate = rep(NA, nrow(data))
for (name in unique(A$file)) {
  ref = A[A$file == name,]
  test = data[data$file == name,]
  rate[data$file == name]=
      dnorm(test$arousal, correct.avp(ref$arousal), ref$arousal.s)*
      dnorm(test$valence, correct.avp(ref$arousal), ref$valence.s)*
      dnorm(test$potency, correct.avp(ref$arousal), ref$potency.s)*
      dnorm(test$contempt, correct.c(ref$arousal), ref$contempt.s)
}
hist(log(rate))
```

```{r}
RW= aggregate.data.frame(rate, list(data$workerId), FUN="mean")
BESTW = RW$Group.1[log(RW$x) > -50]
writeLines(as.character(BESTW[!is.na(BESTW)]), 'bestworkers.csv')
hist(log(RW$x))
```

# Select images
```{r}
normals = c("lfw/Charles_Rogers/Charles_Rogers_0001.jpg",
            "img_align_celeba/000019.jpg",
            "img_align_celeba/117045.jpg",
            "img_align_celeba/010260.jpg",
            "img_align_celeba/000157.jpg")
B = data.frame(
  file= A$file,
  arousal= correct.avp(A$arousal),
  valence= correct.avp(A$valence),
  potency= correct.avp(A$potency),
  contempt= correct.c(A$contempt)
)
for (normal in normals)
  B[B$file == normal,c('arousal','valence','potency','contempt')]=c(jitter(c(50,50,50)),0)
write.csv(B, "../bestrep.csv", row.names=F)
nrow(B)
```

```{r}
plot(B[,c('arousal','valence','potency','contempt')])
```
